caption: The drawing depicts two objects that are mirror images of each other, placed side by side with their curved sides facing inward, creating a roughly symmetrical composition. Each object is shaped like a partial arc or horseshoe, with multiple small, rectangular holes along the outer edge. The objects are primarily dark brown with lighter brown highlights and irregular patches, giving them a rusted or weathered appearance. The background is a uniform, light beige color, providing contrast and emphasizing the objects in the center of the drawing. The objects are spaced slightly apart at the top, with the open ends of the arcs not touching, and they are aligned vertically. There is no additional detail or ornamentation elsewhere in the drawing.
title: Ox Shoes
